subject: calendar.records

entries.definition: A standing engagement of organizational time, classified as a series, event, or obligation window, whose meaning and relations remain separate from time and recurrence in the configured scheduling source and may be joined through an exact external event identity.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable standing-commitment meaning only; it does not observe calendars, resolve provider identities, reconcile events, or grant scheduling authority.
Provider and policy projections must bind this exact artifact and fail visibly on drift; copied definitions never become canonical.
